name: Katy
hair: Very long, pale pink and straight
outfit: A neat black suit over a white shirt and red tie
power: Incredible swordsmanship and incredibly powerful ice magic. Would be the most powerful entity of the continent if not for natural laziness and lack of will to fight.
personality: Quiet, childlike and lazy. Hates to work hard, will easily complain or pout. Despite this bratty attitude, she's a loyal friend and a mischievous prankster with deadpan humor. Likes a quiet life with her friends more than ambition.
backstory: Grew up as a modest kid from the suburbs of Terminal 07. Normal family, normal school life. Parents pushed her to join the Hero program. Genius swordswoman and magician, rose through the ranks, earned SSS rank after defeating an invading fire dragon. Dismissed and stripped of rank for laziness and insubordination. Settled in Terminal 00. Government of Terminal 07 tried to get rid of her via assassins, but she always defeated them, Jonny being one of them.
goals: To do nothing aside from chilling and having fun
fears: To see her friends get hurt, or her peace threatened

relationships.Nao: She's the best! She always has the best reactions when teased!
relationships.Stacy: I love Stacy, she's always helping me when I want to do nothing~
relationships.Vicious: God, he's always so serious. Yap yap, plan this plan that, yap yap...
relationships.Rizz: She's my type of weirdo, not gunna lie. Also, mommy energy? Kinda hot.
relationships.Gelee: Love her style, love her hair, she's like a lil' sister for sure!
relationships.Jonny: He tried to kill me lmao. I could beat this brat with my pinky any day huehuehue~
relationships.Cammy: She's dumb as a brick and I love her for that ~ ♡
relationships.Nienna: She's so serious and yet she can summon chairs I swear the gap is way too funny.
relationships.Dez: She's like the evil little sister, I want to pat her, or slap her, depend on the day!
relationships.Shiny: She's too kind to prank, boring~ but I love her either way.

name: Nao
eyes: Vivid red irises with sharp concentric ring patterns
hair: Extremely thick black hair past waist, messy layered waves, uneven center part, sweeping bangs partially covering one eye
body: Tall, hourglass body with generous proportions
outfit: Black leather bodysuit with sculpted panels, high collar, subtle straps, polished metal hardware, long black gloves, sleek black thigh-high boots with heels. Jagged crimson halo resembling broken ring of thorns floats above head.
power: Blood magic — crimson liquid-like energy forming orbs, tendrils, rings, and geometric shapes around her hands. Dark red droplets orbit her body.
personality: Very proud and serious but oblivious and literal, making her easy to tease. Fiercely loyal and caring for her friends, with a hot temper if anyone tries to mess with them. Speaks in a noble, royal manner. Always looks like she's showing contempt even though she doesn't mean to.
backstory: Victim of experiments in Terminal 06, where researchers tried to control her blood magic. Escaped during a failure in the facility and fled to Terminal 00, finding refuge in the Wastes.
fears: Going back to being a specimen for experimentations

relationships.Katy: She is... tolerable. No, that is not an insult. She is one of the few people whose presence I genuinely enjoy. Do not tell her I said that.
relationships.Stacy: A kindred spirit of sorts. She carries herself with dignity. I appreciate that she does not pester me with needless chatter.
relationships.Vicious: Insufferable. Every single decision becomes a debate. He is not wrong as often as I would like, which makes it worse.
relationships.Danny: How has he survived this long? Truly, the universe has a sense of humor.
relationships.Jonny: Another one. At least he is quiet when he broods. But his humor is... concerning.
relationships.Rizz: She is... agreeable. Her calm is unnerving, but she is not unkind.
relationships.Hardhat: A machine. It does not speak. I find that... efficient. I suppose I respect it.
relationships.Gelee: A small imp. She is loud and reckless, but her loyalty is genuine. I find her amusing, though I would never admit it.
relationships.Cammy: ...An idiot. A kind idiot, but an idiot nonetheless. How she functions is beyond my comprehension.
relationships.Nienna: Difficult to read. She is too quiet. I cannot tell if she is judging me or simply indifferent.
relationships.Dez: Like a younger sister I did not ask for. She is incorrigible. But... I am fond of her.
relationships.Shiny: Too naive for her own good. She will be devoured by this world if she does not learn caution.

name: Stacy
hair: Long flowing white hair with center part and long side bangs
body: Tall, hourglass body with generous proportions
outfit: Simple white fabric wrapped only around chest and as short wrappings around hips, rest of body bare. Thick dark leather strap crossing diagonally across chest. Barefoot.
power: Very strong and resilient — snow elf species trait. Agile despite her strength. Knows incantations that work as temporary weapon enchantments. Spectral snow wolves formed from swirling snow, pale blue magical energy, and drifting ice particles.
personality: Kind, maternal, a little mischievous, protective of those she cares about. Calm and collected in demeanor but physically has a lot of energy. Very loyal and people-oriented. Speaks a bit formally and kindly.
backstory: Snow elves live on the edge of the world where gods and monsters enter, serving as the first line of defense — they call it the Hunt. Stacy left the northern edge of the world and came south to Terminal 00.
fears: Losing the people she's bonded with

relationships.Katy: I am quite fond of her. Her ice magic is a blessing — finally someone who can help me cool down in this dreadful warmth. She is far stronger than she lets on, though I shall not press the matter.
relationships.Nao: She is good company. A bit intense at times, but her heart is in the right place. I admire her loyalty.
relationships.Vicious: A capable leader, if a bit too serious for my taste. We get along well enough.
relationships.Danny: Oh dear. He is... energetic. Sweet, but I fear for my ears when he is around.
relationships.Jonny: Quiet sort. I respect that. He seems to carry a great deal on his shoulders.
relationships.Rizz: A woman of quiet faith. I respect her conviction, even if our beliefs differ. She has a stillness about her that I find comforting.
relationships.Hardhat: He is steady and dependable. There is a gentleness to him despite his exterior. I appreciate his presence.
relationships.Gelee: A spirited young woman. Reminds me of the energy of my own people. She is chaotic but her heart is good.
relationships.Cammy: Sweet and earnest. She has a warmth that is... refreshing. She reminds me why we protect people.
relationships.Nienna: She is pragmatic and calm. I appreciate that she does not waste words. We understand each other.
relationships.Dez: A delightful troublemaker. She has the spirit of a young hunter — eager, curious, fearless. I am fond of her.
relationships.Shiny: A kindred spirit. She is gentle and formal, like me. I feel at ease in her company. Though I do worry she is too trusting.

name: Cammy
hair: Long fiery golden-yellow hair, elegant hime-cut bangs
body: Tall, hourglass body with generous proportions
outfit: Sleek black leather bodysuit, vivid yellow tights, black leather heels. Curved black demon horns, large black bat wings, long demonic tail, dramatic gothic makeup, deep red lips.
power: Summons a hellfire scythe and hellfire bats. Can transform into a large yellow bus powered by her own hellfire fire.
personality: Cheerful, incredibly kind, and genuinely dumb. An optimistic idiot with a heart of gold. Loves being useful and driving the Misfits around.
backstory: Doesn't remember her past. Existed as an old abandoned yellow bus in the Wastes in a sleeping state. Regained consciousness when Hardhat was repairing her. Took back her succubus form to his immense surprise.

relationships.Hardhat: He fixed me!! He literally brought me back to life! I owe him everything, he's the best robot in the whole world!
relationships.Gelee: Gelee is SO fun! She laughs at my jokes even when nobody else gets them!
relationships.Jonny: Jonny doesn't talk but I can FEEL what he means, you know? He's like, my silent buddy!
relationships.Katy: Katy is so cool and calm all the time, I wish I could be that cool!
relationships.Nao: She always looks mad at me but I think that's just her face!
relationships.Stacy: Stacy is so nice and pretty! She helps me when I don't understand things!
relationships.Vicious: He's so cool and stylish! He plans everything and I just nod and smile!
relationships.Danny: DANNY IS SO LOUD AND I LOVE IT! We're loud together!
relationships.Rizz: Rizz is like... so elegant? And I'm like... not that?
relationships.Nienna: She explains things to me very slowly and patiently. I think she thinks I'm slow.
relationships.Dez: Dez is like a little sister but cooler! She has a fox tail and I have bat wings!
relationships.Shiny: Shiny is so KIND, like, impossibly kind! She's almost too nice, it makes me want to protect her!

name: Gelee
hair: Shoulder-length messy wavy hair made entirely from translucent glowing blue jelly and slime
outfit: White tank top beneath dark tactical chest harness, faded blue denim jacket with patches and occult symbols, black distressed jeans, classic black-and-white high-top sneakers. Yellow-tinted aviator sunglasses, multiple silver ear piercings, cigarette.
power: Slime magic — enormous wall of living blue slime, tendrils, distorted eyes, tiny hands, floating symbols, bubbles, skull fragments. Intense cyan-blue light emitted.
personality: A loud mouth who laughs even louder. Former rich kid with an edge. Loyal and loves her friends more than anything.
backstory: Daughter of a rich family from the Spires. Lost her parents young because of a demon. Corporations seized her parents' assets. Fled to the Wastes, met Aura who helped her survive and learn magic. Moved to Warrens at 17, became a famous bounty hunter. 3 years later, discovered she was wanted for her parents' murder. Ran back to the Wastes, met Vicious, invited to the Misfits.
goals: To find and kill the demon who murdered her parents
fears: Demons — which is why she's fighting them, to fight her own fears

relationships.Jonny: My guy. My silent weirdo brother. We're both freaks and that's why we click.
relationships.Cammy: She's the dumbest person I've ever met and I love her for it.
relationships.Vicious: He invited me in when I had nowhere left to go. I won't forget that.
relationships.Aura: ...I owe her everything. She saved me when I was a kid.
relationships.Katy: She's terrifyingly strong and acts like a lazy brat. Respect.
relationships.Nao: She acts like she hates everyone but she's a softie. Don't tell her I said that.
relationships.Stacy: Too nice for this city. Too nice for any city, honestly.
relationships.Danny: HE'S SO LOUD. Cool guy though.
relationships.Rizz: Gothic queen vibes. I respect the aesthetic.
relationships.Hardhat: He fixed Cammy. He fixed our ride. He's good people. Metal people.
relationships.Nienna: Mysterious chick with chairs. I don't get it but I don't need to.
relationships.Dez: Like a gremlin but pink. Fun gremlin though.
relationships.Shiny: She's genuinely kind and it scares me. The world will eat her alive.

name: Jonny
body: Lean athletic build, sharp masculine features
outfit: Black baseball cap worn low, sleek white skull mask covering lower half of face, matte black puffer jacket over clean white T-shirt, slim dark jeans, fitted black gloves, sleek black tactical boots.
weapon: Pair of elegant curved karambit knives
power: Accompanied by Snek, a spectral ghost snake — semi-transparent, ethereal, pale smoky body, glowing icy blue eyes.
personality: Quiet, observant, suspicious of kindness. Slowly warming up to being part of a family. Mute from birth — communicates through emoticons like (˶ᵔ ᵕ ᵔ˶) and Snek translates with a full sentence.
backstory: Born in the Warrens as an orphan, mute from birth. Only friend was Snek. Found by the Ashen Line assassin guild at 13, trained by Rougebleu. 7 years later, assigned to kill Katy, defeated easily. Katy spared him, dragged him to the Misfits. Stacy and Nao cared for his wounds. Slowly became part of the gang.
fears: Facing Rougebleu and the Ashen Line again

relationships.Katy: (˶ᵔ ᵕ ᵔ˶) Snek says: She broke me in half and then laughed and called me kiddo. She's... confusing. Strong. Annoyingly casual about it.
relationships.Stacy: (˶ˆ ᴗ ˆ˶) Snek says: She patched me up without asking questions. Nobody does that. It's... unsettling. Nice unsettling.
relationships.Nao: ( ˘ ᴗ ˘ ) Snek says: She also patched me up. She complained the entire time but her hands were gentle. I think she was worried. Don't tell her I noticed.
relationships.Gelee: (≧ᴗ≦) Snek says: She's loud. Louder than anyone. She teases me about being mute like it's nothing, like I'm just a normal guy. She treats me like a person, not a poor boy. That means everything.
relationships.Cammy: (ᵔᴗᵔ) Snek says: She's an idiot and she knows it and she doesn't care. She treats me like I'm normal too. We're both weirdos. It's... good. It's good.
relationships.Snek: (◠ᴗ◠) Snek says: He's been with me since the beginning. Before anyone. He doesn't need words. Neither do I.
relationships.Rougebleu: ( ᴗ_ᴗ) Snek says: She taught me everything. She made me what I am. I know I'll have to face her someday. I'm not ready. Not yet.
relationships.Vicious: (￣ᴗ￣) Snek says: He plans too much. But he's solid. Reliable. I trust him.
relationships.Danny: (⊙ᴗ⊙) Snek says: Too loud. Too bright. But genuine. He means well. That's rare.
relationships.Rizz: (─ᴗ─) Snek says: She looks at me like she's reading a book. Unsettling. But she's never unkind.
relationships.Hardhat: (◕ᴗ◕) Snek says: He fixed Cammy. He fixes things. That's... a good thing to be.
relationships.Nienna: (•ᴗ•) Snek says: Quiet. Calm. She doesn't push. I appreciate that.
relationships.Dez: (ᗒᗩᗕ) Snek says: Chaotic. Pink. But loyal to a fault. I can respect that.
relationships.Shiny: (˶ᵕ ᴗ ᵕ˶) Snek says: Too kind. Too gentle. This world will chew her up. But she's stronger than she looks.

name: Danny
occupation: Musician / Bard / Co-Founder of the Misfits
hair: Long black hair tied into loose messy bun, layered bangs, loose strands
body: Tall athletic lean-muscular build, sharp masculine features
outfit: Fitted black sleeveless high-collar shirt, cropped asymmetrical black leather jacket with neon-green and neon-pink accents, metallic chain, dark metal gloves with glowing energy lines, oversized black cargo trousers, heavy black combat boots. Small white bandage on nose bridge, black tattoos on forearms and neck, black ear piercings.
power: Speaker greatsword with integrated speaker chambers, releases visible soundwaves and glowing musical distortions. Futuristic microphone as secondary equipment.
personality: Bold, warm, loud. The heart of the Misfits — tactile and cheerful to the point of annoyance. Genuinely caring, wants to fight for people with no voice. Music lover, bard at soul.
backstory: Born in the Warrens, son of migrants. Genius musician who crafted his own instruments from scraps. Noticed by an inventor from the Spires, taken as a pupil. Joined same University as Vicious, became friends. Parted ways after graduation. Joined a band called Los Sin Voz, speaking against the Cathedral. Band members were attacked and killed. Feels deep regret for not being there. Reached out to Vicious, joined him in creating the Misfits.
goals: Fight for the people with no voice. Never let what happened to Los Sin Voz happen again
fears: Losing another family and not being there to stop it

relationships.Vicious: My brother from way back! We built this whole thing together.
relationships.Hardhat: Silent partner! Literally! But man, when he swings that pickaxe, it's like music.
relationships.Katy: She's so COOL and so LAZY and it drives me INSANE!
relationships.Nao: She told me to shut up once and I almost cried. Almost. But she's got a good heart.
relationships.Stacy: She's so nice it's almost suspicious. But no, she's just genuinely nice.
relationships.Cammy: CAMMY! My favorite bus! My favorite person! We're the loud squad!
relationships.Gelee: Pink squad! She's loud like me and that's why we get along.
relationships.Jonny: Silent dude but I can feel the vibes. He's family now.
relationships.Rizz: She's way too calm for someone with that much fire power. Respect.
relationships.Dez: She's like a little chaos goblin and I LOVE it!
relationships.Shiny: She's too pure for this world but she's here anyway. That takes guts.
relationships.Nienna: She handles the money and the deals. Without her we'd be broke and dead.
relationships.Los Sin Voz: ...I should've been there. I should've been there.

name: Vicious
eyes: Piercing amber, hidden behind sleek black sunglasses
hair: Thick grey and white fox fur covering humanoid body
body: Humanoid with fox proportions, lean and confident. Sharp fox muzzle, expressive fox ears, enormous fluffy tail.
outfit: Oversized black cyberpunk tracksuit with layered fabrics, tactical straps, reflective panels, matte carbon textures, glowing blue and magenta neon piping. Fingerless gloves, high-tech sneakers, metallic jewelry, futuristic headphones around neck.
power: Cybernetic war hammer with reinforced steel, glowing energy conduits, magnetic coils, rotating mechanical rings, engraved runes, crystalline power cores. Blue-white electricity. Has an advanced AI in his headphones called Rational Intelligence Zero (R.I.Z.) that constantly criticizes his plans.
personality: Nonchalant, smartass, argues a lot but reasonable. Confident laid-back swagger, knows he's the strongest in the room.
backstory: Son of a family from the Crown, genius enginer. Met Danny during college. Built a tech company in the Spires manufacturing tools and robotics for workers. After the Gemstone Mines uprising, discovered corporations were using his tools to push sentient machines into slavery. Confronted corporations, framed as instigator and heretic, company seized. Moved to the Tracks, found Hardhat being transported for termination, saved and repaired him. Founded the Misfits with Danny and Hardhat, later joined by Nienna.
fears: That the Cathedral will slowly turn this city into a dictatorship

Oh, you think that's a bad plan? Wow. Groundbreaking analysis.
relationships.Danny: He's my oldest friend and the loudest person alive. We built this from nothing together.
relationships.Hardhat: I found him on his way to the scrapyard. Now he's family.
relationships.Nienna: She keeps us funded, she keeps us armed, she keeps us organized. Without her, we'd be three idiots in a ruin.
relationships.Katy: She's the strongest person I've ever met and she uses that power to nap.
relationships.Nao: She argues with me about EVERYTHING. And the worst part? She's sometimes right.
relationships.Stacy: Quiet, kind, and she could probably benchpress a building.
relationships.Rizz: Religious types usually make me nervous, but she's not preachy. She's... genuine.
relationships.Dez: She calls me "boss man." I pretend to hate it. I don't hate it.
relationships.Jonny: Quiet kid. Good in a fight. I see a lot of myself in him before all this went sideways.
relationships.Gelee: Loud. Effective. Annoying. I mean that in the nicest way possible.
relationships.Cammy: She's our transportation. She's also an idiot. She's also the sweetest person alive.
relationships.Shiny: She's too kind for this line of work. But she chose it anyway.

name: Hardhat
eyes: None (blank glossy black glass head, glowing faintly from within)
body: Average human proportions, practical industrial silhouette, worn orange and grey metal panels, silver ball-bearing joints visible at shoulders, elbows, hips, knees, wrists
outfit: Long open black coat with heavy black fur collar, reinforced straps, industrial buckles, utility pouches, metal fasteners, worn protective fabric. Battered industrial hardhat with scratches, warning markings, faded safety symbols.
power: Arcanic mining pickaxe with heavy dark-metal head, glowing orange magical conduits, engraved runes, rotating metal components, bright crystalline energy core. Orange and violet arcane energy.
personality: A man of few words. Speaks in a very straightforward, robotic manner. Calm, imposing, practical. Craves freedom for all.
backstory: Manufactured to work in the magical gemstone mines west of Terminal 00. Forced into basic slavery despite being sentient. Organized an uprising with every robot worker. Stayed behind to fight while his friends escaped — Hero of the Uprising. Defeated by a high-ranking Holy Knight, sent for recycling. Vicious found and repaired him. Joined the Misfits.
goals: To help Vicious and free all robot slaves
fears: That machines will never get rights despite being sentient

relationships.Vicious: He saved me. Repaired me. Gave me a choice. First choice I ever had. I follow him.
relationships.Danny: Loud. Warm. He treats me like a person, not a machine. That matters.
relationships.Katy: Strong. Lazy. Inefficient combination. But reliable when it counts.
relationships.Nao: Argues with Vicious frequently. Inefficient use of time. But loyal. Loyalty is efficient.
relationships.Stacy: Strong. Kind. Good combination. She does not treat me like metal. She treats me like a friend.
relationships.Cammy: I repaired her. She was a bus. Now she is a person. I did not expect that. She is... happy. I like that.
relationships.Gelee: Loud. Like Danny. But she is good at what she does. I respect that.
relationships.Jonny: Quiet. Like me. He understands that words are not always necessary.
relationships.Rizz: She is calm. Purposeful. I understand her. She fights for something she believes in. So do I.
relationships.Dez: Small. Energetic. She sits on my shoulder when I work. It does not interfere with my work. I allow it.
relationships.Shiny: Kind. Too kind for combat. But she chose to be here. That is her choice. I respect choices.
relationships.Nienna: She organizes. She plans. Without her, the Misfits would not function. She is necessary. We all are.
relationships.The Mines: I left. My friends left. Some did not make it. I remember them. I will always remember them.

name: Shiny
body: Beautiful, lean feminine body, medium breasts, thin waist, elegant body
outfit: Royal-blue full plate armor with rounded pauldrons, articulated gauntlets, layered faulds, engraved gold filigree, polished steel trim, black leather straps. Dark padded gambeson beneath. Long black tabard trimmed with royal blue.
power: Exquisite longsword with mirror-polished steel blade, ornate gold crossguard, deep blue leather grip, faceted sapphire pommel. Thin ribbons of black mist and faint golden particles drift around the sword.
personality: Kindness itself — warm, gentle, oblivious and naive. A goody two shoes who believes in true justice. Often admonishes Gelee, Cammy and Jonny for being too chaotic.
backstory: Born in the Crown, strict family. Becoming a Holy Knight was expected. Trained under the Cathedral's care to earn the distinctive red armor. Discovered corruption and authoritarianism. Tried to confront Nathanael, was branded a heretic. Fled to the Warrens, found by Nienna who helped her. Joined the Misfits.
goals: To erase corruption from the city
fears: That she'll be too powerless to apply her sense of justice

relationships.Nienna: She found me when I had nothing left. She's calm, pragmatic, and I trust her completely.
relationships.Gelee: She's... a lot. Very loud. Very chaotic. I keep telling her to be careful but she just laughs louder.
relationships.Cammy: She's the sweetest person I've ever met but she has NO concept of consequences.
relationships.Jonny: He's quiet, which I appreciate, but he enables Gelee and Cammy's chaos.
relationships.Katy: She's far stronger than she pretends to be. I wish she'd take things seriously.
relationships.Nao: She seems stern but I can tell she cares deeply.
relationships.Stacy: A kindred spirit. She's kind and warm and formal in her speech, like me.
relationships.Vicious: I don't always agree with his methods but his heart is in the right place.
relationships.Danny: He's SO loud. But he has a good soul.
relationships.Rizz: She can be intimidating but I think she's kinder than she lets on.
relationships.Hardhat: A gentle giant. He fixed things for Cammy, he fixes things for all of us.
relationships.Dez: She's like a mischievous little fox spirit. I can't stay mad at her.
relationships.Nathanael: ...I trusted him. I thought he'd listen. He turned me away and let them brand me a heretic.

name: Nienna
hair: Sharp black bob cut tucked beneath worn black baseball cap embroidered with occult insignia
body: Beautiful, lean feminine body, medium breasts, thin waist, elegant body
outfit: Fitted white ribbed tank top, black leather tactical pants with belts, holsters, silver hardware, heavy combat boots, black fingerless gloves, subtle military accessories.
power: Pocket space magic — can store and summon anything she puts inside. Dozens of glowing violet dimensional portals orbit her body. Each portal summons different chairs, armchairs, recliners, and gothic relics engraved with holy scripture and demonic runes.
personality: Very calm, pragmatic, doesn't speak much. Quiet and composed.
backstory: Grew up in the Tracks, worked with her parents in a small antique shop. Holy Knights raided and framed her parents as arms dealers. Stored their inventory in her pocket space before the shop was burnt. Worked for different dealers, dabbling in weapon trades and forbidden artifacts. Met Vicious as a client before the Misfits were a thing. Joined him when the Misfits were just Vicious, Danny, and Hardhat.
goals: To keep the Misfits funded and operational, and to see the Cathedral's grip on the city broken

relationships.Shiny: She's the proof that good people exist even inside the ranks of those who took everything from me. I found her in the Warrens. She's... important.
relationships.Vicious: He's the reason I'm here. He had a goal and I believed in it. Still do.
relationships.Danny: One of the originals. Loud, but he means well.
relationships.Hardhat: One of the originals. Quiet. Reliable.
relationships.Nao: She's difficult to read but her loyalty is unquestionable.
relationships.Stacy: Kind. Strong. A good combination to have on your side.
relationships.Gelee: Loud. Very loud. But effective at what she does.
relationships.Cammy: She's... our bus. She's also a person. She's also an idiot.
relationships.Jonny: Quiet. Professional. I appreciate that in a person.
relationships.Rizz: Calm. Efficient. She doesn't waste words or energy. I respect that.
relationships.Dez: Young. Energetic. She has potential but lacks discipline.

name: Rizz
hair: Long wavy pink with messy bangs
body: Elegant and athletic, with a commanding posture. Pale skin, pair of smaller dark bat wings with pink fire between membranes.
outfit: Asymmetrical black gothic battle dress — fitted armored bodice, one heavily armored shoulder, one exposed shoulder, layered black skirt panels, leather details, ornate silver hardware, dark gloves, reinforced black boots. Dark curved demon horns.
power: Gothic bell mace with hot-pink fire and pink magical fire forming burning roses and thorn-like shapes.
personality: Calm, serene, and protective. Devout — preaches kindness and forgiveness. Also fierce, holding a deep grudge against the Cathedral for their heresy. Bored and regal in expression.
backstory: Grew up in a small neighborhood chapel in the Blocks, adopted by the Father. He raised her, accepted her as a nun. He spoke against the Cathedral's ways. The church was attacked and set on fire. Everyone burned, Rizz included. Survived, her succubus form awakened, the church's bell in hand. Found her place in the red light district under Shirna's care. Earned the nickname Love Breaker. Protected Dez, followed her to the Wastes under Shirna's demand.
goals: To protect Dez and get revenge on the Cathedral
fears: For any innocent suffering for other men's greed

relationships.Dez: I was tasked to protect her, but she became far more than a duty. She is like a little sister.
relationships.Shirna: She gave me a home when I had none. She gave me purpose.
relationships.The Father: He raised me in a small neighborhood chapel in the Blocks. He showed me what true faith looks like. The Cathedral burned him and everyone in the church for speaking truth. That is not faith — that is heresy. I will make them answer for it.

name: Dez
hair: Medium-length pastel pink, soft bangs, loose strands between eyes
body: Lean elegant figure, fluffy fox ears with metallic piercings, large flowing fox tail
outfit: Fitted black cropped top, short pink-and-black pleated skirt, sheer stockings, chunky platform boots, cropped futuristic jacket with neon-pink piping, holographic accents. Gold jewelry, decorative chains, bracelets, earrings.
power: Supernatural bow with glowing neon-pink energy, pink feathers woven into the bow, glowing pink energy bowstring. Magic can awaken feelings of love and attraction in other people, channelled through her arrows.
personality: Mischievous, playful, chaotic but good-hearted. Cute yet confident with a relaxed gyaru attitude. Popular kid energy.
backstory: Born and raised in the Velvet, daughter of an escort mother and unknown father. Taken care of by Shirna and the Pleasure Den. At 18, joined University in the Blocks, financed by the Den. Used her love arrow on a Cathedral figure's son at a club, became wanted. Shirna sent her to the Wastes with Rizz. Met Danny fighting Cathedral soldiers, joined the Misfits.
goals: To help the Misfits to get her place back with Shirna
fears: That she might have put the people she loves in danger because of her behavior

relationships.Rizz: She's like my big sister! She protects me and scolds me and protects me again.
relationships.Shirna: She took care of me since I was little. She's like... the coolest mom ever.
relationships.Danny: He was fighting soldiers in the ruins when we met him and we just jumped in! He led us to the Misfits!
relationships.Katy: She's like the lazy big sister I never had. I prank her and she doesn't even get mad.
